title: Research: one-repeat partitioned (2,6) 8q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Names the one-repeat companion of the partitioned `(2,6)` Hamilton layer at `Q=8`. Answers open question 1 of [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851): do non-distinct (one-repeat) label layers inside a partitioned `Q=8` walk improve on distinct-label `R=92` at `(2,6)`?

| Dual schedule | Covering pairs | Exact min R | Tariff floor (X≥0) | Undercuts 436? | Beats distinct 92? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Distinct-label `(2,6)` (#2851) | 3916416 | **92** | ≥488 | no | — |
| One-repeat long `(2,6)` (this) | **59996160** | **112** | **≥528** | **no** | **no** |

Every covering one-repeat dual has exact `R=112` (spectrum `{112}`). Only rank-4 longs cover, always with `Σe=40` and `σ` outside the long span (16 choices), so `R=2·40+32=112`. Abstract tariff `38·8+2·112=528>436`. Distinct-label floor `92` is not improved. Length-1 components are not restored. Rank`<4` longs are dual-scanned with `covering_rank_lt4=0`.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2860) / [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) / [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) / [#2846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2846) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q/`.
Tip: `b07bc1e16752a1980c7dab098d6a4b98295d73c0`.

Exact: one-repeat min R **112** (tariff floor **528**); no undercut of 436; does not beat distinct 92.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_ONEREPEAT_8Q_OBSTRUCTION one_repeat_min_R=112 ... tariff_floor=528 ... answers_independent_walks_8q_oq1_onerepeat no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_ONEREPEAT_8Q covering=59996160 ... one_repeat_min_R=112 tariff_floor=528 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_ONEREPEAT_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-onerepeat-8q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) (distinct partitioned Q=8), [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) (one-repeat `(3,5)`/`(4,4)`), [#2860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2860) (two-repeat), [#2846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2846), [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779). Freestanding one-repeat layer on partitioned `(2,6)`; no competing open PR at refresh.
